name: Indian Bank
revisionRemark: Indian Bank is one of the corresponding new Banks constituted under the provisions of Section 3 of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970. In terms of proviso to Section 3(2D) of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 (The Act), the foreign shareholding in our Bank should not be more than 20% of paid up capital of the Bank.  As against the foreign limit of 20% prescribed in the Act, the foreign holding in our Bank as on 31.12.2023 is 5.89%
